interpretation.established: Reported steady-meter levels: VSYS and H_RF_VDD 6.3 V, VDD 4.5 V, PIR supply 3.3 V with sensor connected. These establish levels in the reported state, not transient regulation or complete function.
interpretation.TP14: P1 was placed at TP14, not at the red battery solder terminal. B53=0 V disputes its modeled BATTERY+ association. Compare the two physical points before changing topology.
interpretation.VREF: The printed VREF test point read 0 V in this red-blinking state. No fixed reference voltage or fault mechanism is inferred; it may be state-dependent or require further receiver/PIC diagnosis.
interpretation.identity: 4.5 V and 3.3 V are consistent with the selected U1/U6 voltage variants, but do not uniquely identify their manufacturers or prove all pin roles.
